identity.title: The Missing Moon Lantern
identity.logline: The village's Moon Lantern vanished the night before the festival. Find out who took it, and why.
identity.setting: Pebblebrook, a tiny hillside village that lights one big paper lantern every full moon.
identity.tone: Warm, gentle and a little funny.

style_guide.narrator_voice: A friendly storyteller using short, cosy sentences.
use: small sensory details like smells and sounds
style_guide.naming_conventions: Short, soft village names with a country feel.

lines: Oh dear, the festival without the lantern? Have a bun and let us think.
Hm. Gears. Always the gears. Do not touch that one, please.

cast.name: Mira
cast.personality: Warm, chatty baker who worries about everyone.
cast.goal: Make sure the festival goes ahead.
cast.secret: She saw a light in the clock tower but thought nothing of it.
cast.sprite_recipe: round woman, flour-white apron, brown bun hair
cast.voice_notes: Cheerful, offers food, rambles a little.

cast.name: Oswin
cast.personality: Fussy librarian owl who loves rules and tidy shelves.
cast.secret: He keeps a spare tower key and a log of who borrows it.
cast.sprite_recipe: small brown owl with round glasses

goal_states.description: Oswin gets his overdue book back.

cast.voice_notes: Precise, a bit stuffy, warms up when thanked.

cast.name: Pip
cast.personality: Curious garden cat who sees everything at night.
cast.goal: Be told she is a good detective.
cast.secret: She sat on the garden wall all night and watched the tower.
cast.sprite_recipe: small orange tabby with a white tail tip
cast.voice_notes: Short purring sentences, speaks in hints.

cast.name: Hollis
cast.personality: Shy clock keeper who hates to admit mistakes.
cast.goal: Fix the lantern before anyone notices it was cracked.
cast.secret: He borrowed the Moon Lantern to mend a crack and could not finish in time.
cast.sprite_recipe: tall thin man, grey cardigan, thick spectacles

goal_states.description: Hollis is told that nobody is angry and agrees to bring the lantern back.

truths.text: The Moon Lantern vanished the night before the festival.
Someone climbed the clock tower stairs that night.
Hollis the clock keeper took the lantern.
Hollis only wanted to mend a crack in it and was too ashamed to say so.

clues.text: Mira says the lantern's hook on the square is empty this morning.
A festival notice with a gap where the lantern should hang.
Pip saw a tall figure carry a glow up the tower stairs.
The key log shows the tower key was out all night.
Oswin, now friendly, names Hollis in the key log.
The glass shard fits the lantern frame on the tower bench.
Hollis admits he wanted to repair the crack in secret.
Fish glue and tiny brushes lie beside the half-mended lantern.
Floury footprints lead out of the bakery towards the square.

twists.description: The lantern was not stolen. It was taken for repair by someone gentle.

red_herrings.description: Floury footprints make Mira look suspicious.
red_herrings.resolution: The prints are Mira's own from delivering festival buns.

endings.scene_outline: Hollis carries the mended lantern to the square and the village lights it together.
endings.epilogue_notes: Mira shares buns. Pip is named Chief Detective.
